FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

DHA Karachi mein pest control ki kitni cost hoti hai?

SafaiKaro mein general fumigation DHA mein Rs 7,000 se shuru hoti hai 100 sq yards tak ke ghar ke liye. 101–200 sq yards ke liye Rs 11,000. All prices are published upfront  -  no hidden charges, ever.

Kya same-day service available hai?

Yes  -  if you book before 10am, same-day slots are often available. Our technicians cover DHA Phase 1-8 and Clifton daily. Call or WhatsApp to check availability.

Kya treatment bachon aur pets ke liye safe hai?

All chemicals we use are WHO-approved and safe for re-entry after 4 hours. We recommend keeping children and pets out of treated rooms during and for 4 hours post-treatment.

Fumigation mein kitna time lagta hai?

A standard 3-bed house takes 2-3 hours. We notify you before arrival with an estimated window. You can usually return home the same day.

Kya aap written guarantee dete ho?

Yes  -  all treatments come with a 90-day guarantee. If pests return within 90 days, we return and re-treat at no additional cost. Termite treatments carry a 5-year written warranty.

Karachi mein aap kahan kahan serve karte ho?

DHA Phase 1 through Phase 8 and Clifton Block 1-9 remain our flagship coverage, with technicians based on the ground daily. We now also serve citywide across North Nazimabad, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Nazimabad, Gulberg, Bahadurabad, Tariq Road, Korangi, and other Karachi neighborhoods. WhatsApp us your area to confirm availability. See our fumigation services in Karachi page for full pricing and coverage.

Payment kaise karte hain? Easypaisa/JazzCash chalega?

Yes  -  we accept Easypaisa, JazzCash, bank transfer, and cash on the day. A Rs 500 refundable deposit is required at booking to confirm your slot.

Saal mein kitni baar treatment karwani chahiye?

For most Karachi homes, quarterly treatment (4 times/year) is ideal. Our Annual Shield plan covers exactly this  -  4 visits + 1 emergency callout from Rs 18,000/year. For a standard 200 sq yd house: Rs 24,000/yr  -  save vs booking separately.

## Pricing FAQs

Kya quoted price mein chemicals included hain?
⌄

Yes  -  all prices include equipment, labor, and WHO-approved chemicals. No add-ons, no surprises. The price you see is the price you pay.

Meri property ka size kaise measure karta hoon?
⌄

Property size in Pakistan is measured in square yards. Your property deed or registration documents will show this. A typical DHA Phase 5 house is 200–500 sq yards. If unsure, WhatsApp us  -  we'll help you estimate.

Deposit refundable hai kya?
⌄

Yes  -  if you cancel 24 hours before your appointment, the deposit is fully refunded. Within 24 hours, the deposit is non-refundable to cover technician allocation costs.

Kya prices negotiate ho sakti hain?
⌄

Our prices are fixed and transparent  -  that's the whole point. We don't inflate prices to then negotiate down. What you see is what you pay.

## Baad mein nahi, pehle  -  why timing is everything

Pre-construction treatment slab ke neeche hoti hai  -  soil barrier decades tak protect karta hai

Post-construction mein drilling + injection chahiye  -  mehenga, disturbing, and less effective

Termite damage repair can cost 5–10x more than prevention  -  smart investment ab karo, lakhs bachao baad mein

## Frequently Asked Questions

Pre-construction termite treatment kab karwani chahiye?
⌄

Pre-construction treatment slab pouring se pehle karwani chahiye  -  jab soil abhi exposed ho. Ideal time: after excavation, before the concrete slab is poured. Once construction is complete, you'll need the more expensive post-construction method.

Treatment ke baad ghar mein rehna safe hai?
⌄

For post-construction treatment, you can re-enter after 4 hours. The chemicals we use are WHO-approved and safe for children and pets after the re-entry period. Our technician will give you specific instructions on the day.

5-saal warranty mein kya cover hota hai?
⌄

Our 5-year warranty covers any re-infestation of termites at the treated property. If termites return within 5 years, we return and re-treat at no additional cost. The warranty is registered against your property address.

Kya puri building ka treatment karna zarori hai?
⌄

For maximum effectiveness, yes  -  we recommend treating the entire foundation perimeter and soil beneath the slab. Partial treatment leaves entry points. We'll advise exactly what's needed during the free inspection.

Post-construction mein drilling hoti hai kya?
⌄

Yes  -  post-construction treatment involves drilling small holes (approx 12mm diameter) along the floor-wall junction to inject termiticide. Holes are filled and sealed after treatment. Minimal visual impact.

Treatment kitne time mein complete hoti hai?
⌄

Pre-construction treatment for a 200 sq yd plot takes approximately 3–4 hours. Post-construction treatment for the same size takes 4–6 hours including drilling, injection, and sealing.

## How Our Fumigation Service Works

From booking to a treated home, most fumigation jobs are completed in one visit:

1

### Book & Confirm

WhatsApp +92 330 8652035 with your area and property size. Rs 500 refundable deposit confirms your slot. Pay via Easypaisa, JazzCash, bank transfer, or cash on day.

2

### Technician Arrives & Inspects

Your technician inspects the property, confirms the size tier and price, and identifies high-activity areas: kitchen, drains, skirting boards, and entry points.

3

### Fumigation Treatment

WHO-approved chemicals are applied throughout the property, targeting cockroaches, ants, and crawling insects. A standard 3-bed house (201–300 sq yards) takes 2–3 hours.

4

### Re-Entry & Guarantee

Keep children and pets out of treated rooms for 4 hours after treatment. Your visit is covered by a 90-day guarantee. If pests return within 90 days, we re-treat at no additional cost.

## Safety for Children, Pets & Re-Entry Time

All chemicals used in our fumigation services in Karachi are WHO-approved. We recommend keeping children and pets out of treated rooms during treatment and for 4 hours afterward. After that window, re-entry is safe.

If your property is a school, daycare, or has particularly sensitive occupants, ask about after-hours or holiday scheduling. See our school fumigation service for child-safe, after-hours treatment with a certificate issued after every visit.

## Annual Plan FAQs

Annual plan mein kaunse pests cover hote hain?
⌄

All common household pests  -  cockroaches, ants, flies, mosquitoes, rodents, and general fumigation. Bed bugs require an add-on treatment if discovered. Termite is a separate service.

Emergency callout kab use kar sakte hain?
⌄

Any time within your plan year  -  just WhatsApp us. We typically respond within 2–4 hours for emergencies in DHA and Clifton.

Plan renew karna hai toh kya karna hoga?
⌄

We'll WhatsApp you one month before your plan expires. Renewal gets priority scheduling and a 5% loyalty discount.

What is included in an annual pest control contract?
⌄

SafaiKaro's Annual Shield includes 4 scheduled visits per year covering all common pests (cockroaches, ants, spiders, rodents). Between visits, if pests return, we re-treat free under the guarantee.

How many visits are in an annual pest control plan?
⌄

Our annual plan includes 4 visits  -  one each quarter. Karachi's climate requires quarterly treatment due to monsoon humidity and year-round warmth that sustains pest populations.

## Why Dengue Risk Peaks Every Monsoon in Karachi

Karachi's monsoon season  -  June through September  -  creates ideal conditions for the Aedes aegypti mosquito, the primary vector of dengue fever. As rainfall increases, small collections of standing water form everywhere: coolers, plant pots, blocked drains, roof puddles, and even bottle caps. Each is a potential breeding site.

Dengue is not the only concern. Anopheles mosquitoes  -  which carry malaria  -  also proliferate in the same season. Even non-disease-carrying mosquitoes disrupt sleep and daily life, and their presence in homes with young children or elderly family members is a persistent health stressor.

Machar ka ilaj  -  mosquito treatment  -  is most effective when done proactively, before a dengue case is detected in your neighbourhood. Waiting until after the bite means the cycle is already underway.

The challenge with DIY mosquito sprays and coils is that they suppress adult mosquitoes temporarily but do nothing to interrupt the breeding cycle in standing water. A professional treatment combines both dimensions: fast knockdown of adult mosquitoes plus larvicide that prevents the next generation from hatching.

## German vs American Cockroaches  -  Know What You're Dealing With

Cockroaches in Karachi homes and kitchens fall into two main species, and they behave very differently:

🐛

### German Cockroach (Lal Beg)

Small, light-brown with two dark stripes. The most common kitchen pest in Karachi. Lives inside cabinets, under appliances, and in electrical panels. Reproduces rapidly  -  a single female produces hundreds of offspring per year. Responsible for most kitchen infestations.

🐙

### American Cockroach (Barra Lal Beg)

Large, reddish-brown, often seen at night. Enters homes from drains, sewers, and ground-floor gaps. Common in bathrooms, under sinks, and near utility areas. Spreads bacteria and pathogens from sewers to kitchen surfaces.

Both species are linked to serious health risks. Cockroaches contaminate food and surfaces with bacteria including Salmonella and E. coli. Their shed skins, droppings, and saliva contain allergens that are a documented trigger for asthma and respiratory inflammation  -  particularly in children. In homes where someone already has asthma, a cockroach infestation in the kitchen is a direct health hazard.

Lal beg ka ilaj  -  cockroach treatment  -  must reach the nest, not just the surface. An infestation visible in the kitchen means there are hidden colonies in walls, drain pipes, and under appliances that spray alone will not reach.

## Why DIY Sprays and Repellents Don't Work

Most over-the-counter cockroach sprays, chalk, and repellent strips kill cockroaches they directly contact but fail to resolve an infestation for three reasons:

Eggs survive spraying. Cockroach egg capsules (oothecae) are resistant to most topical sprays. Eggs hatch within weeks, restarting the cycle.

Repellent effect creates scatter. Strong-smelling sprays push cockroaches deeper into walls and appliances, making them harder to reach  -  and extending the infestation.

No IGR  -  no population break. Without an insect growth regulator, nymphs that survive the initial spray reach reproductive age and restart the colony within weeks.

Professional treatment works differently because it targets the colony, not just the individuals you can see.

## SafaiKaro's Three-Layer Cockroach Treatment

Our protocol combines three complementary approaches applied in a single visit:

💊

### Gel Bait

Applied in micro-dots inside hinges, under counters, and inside cabinets. Cockroaches feed on the bait and carry it back to the nest  -  killing the colony from within, including hidden egg-bearing females.

🛣

### Residual Spray

Odourless residual insecticide applied to wall-floor junctions, under appliances, drain surrounds, and harborage points. Kills cockroaches that cross treated surfaces for weeks after application.

🔮

### IGR  -  Insect Growth Regulator

Applied alongside spray, IGR prevents nymphs from maturing into reproductive adults. Breaks the breeding cycle at its source  -  ensuring that even hatching eggs do not produce a new generation.

🚬

### Drain Treatment

Drains under kitchen sinks and bathroom floors are treated separately  -  a critical step that most DIY approaches miss entirely. American cockroaches entering from the sewer are stopped at their entry point.

### Kitchen Safety  -  During & After Treatment

Gel bait applied well away from food-preparation surfaces

No strong odours  -  treatment is discreet and low-disruption

Kitchen usable within 2–3 hours of treatment

Food stored in sealed containers during treatment is safe

WHO-approved chemicals  -  safe for residential kitchens

## Rats vs Mice  -  What's in Your Home and Why It Matters

Karachi homes typically deal with three rodent types, each requiring slightly different treatment approaches:

🐰

### Norway / Brown Rat

Burrowing rat, common in ground floors, kitchens, and behind appliances. Karachi's older neighbourhoods and ground-level DHA homes see high activity. Aggressive gnawer  -  can chew through plastic pipes and soft concrete.

🐱

### Roof Rat (Black Rat)

Agile climber found in upper floors, ceiling cavities, and roof spaces. Common in multi-storey homes in Clifton and DHA. Enters through gaps around pipes, AC units, and rooftop openings.

🦬

### House Mouse

Smaller, can squeeze through gaps as small as 6mm. Often enters kitchens and pantry areas. Reproduces rapidly and contaminates more food per capita than rats due to frequent urination while moving.

Knowing the species matters because roof rats require treatment at ceiling level, while Norway rats are controlled at ground and wall level. SafaiKaro's technicians identify the rodent type during the first visit and place traps and bait stations accordingly.

Chuhe ka khatma  -  rodent control  -  is not just about hygiene. Rats gnaw through electrical wiring and plastic pipes. Wiring damage from rat activity is a documented cause of electrical fires in Pakistani homes. A rodent infestation is a structural and fire-safety risk, not only a health one.

## What Rats and Mice Actually Damage

Beyond contaminating food and surfaces, rodents cause physical damage that compounds over time:

Electrical wiring: Rats gnaw through insulation on wiring. Exposed cables near insulation and dry wood are a direct fire hazard. This is the most serious structural risk of a rodent infestation.

Water pipes: Plastic supply pipes (CPVC, PVC) are targeted. Gnaw damage causes slow leaks and eventual pipe failure inside walls  -  expensive and often invisible until significant water damage has occurred.

Structural wood: Door frames, skirting boards, and wooden beams are gnawed to wear down continuously growing incisors. In older construction, this weakens joints and joinery.

Food contamination: Rodents urinate constantly as they move. Food stored without sealed containers in a rat-active kitchen is contaminated even without direct rat contact.

Disease transmission: Leptospirosis (from urine), hantavirus, salmonella, and rat-bite fever are all associated with rodent infestations. Young children and elderly family members are at highest risk from indirect contact.

## Why Rodenticide-Only Approaches Don't Resolve Infestations

Poison bait placed without trapping or entry-point sealing is the most common reason rodent problems persist despite repeated treatments. Three reasons:

Not all rodents take bait. Rats are neophobic  -  cautious of new objects in their environment. Some will avoid bait stations entirely. Trapping catches individuals that bait does not.

Dead rats inside walls. Rodents that consume poison often die inside wall cavities or ceiling spaces, causing odour problems for weeks. Snap trapping allows removal of carcasses and keeps your home odour-free.

New rats replace old ones. Without sealing entry points, new rodents from outside replace those killed by poison. The infestation appears to reduce and then returns  -  and residents assume the treatment failed. In fact, the structural access was never addressed.

Effective rodent control requires three elements together: trapping, bait stations, and entry-point sealing. Missing any one of the three produces incomplete results.

How many visits does rodent control require?

Why does poison alone not work for rats?

Rodenticide-only approaches fail because not all rats take bait (rats are neophobic), dead rats can die inside walls causing odour, and without sealing entry points, new rodents from outside continually replenish the population. Effective treatment combines trapping, bait stations, and entry-point sealing.

What is a tamper-proof bait station?

A tamper-proof bait station is a lockable container that holds rodenticide inside a secure housing. Rodents enter to feed, but children and pets cannot access the bait. Stations are placed along rodent runways  -  along walls, behind appliances, under sinks  -  for safe, effective bait delivery without open poison placement.

Are rats dangerous beyond food contamination?

Yes. Rats gnaw through electrical wiring (a documented fire risk), plastic water pipes, and structural wood. They also carry leptospirosis, salmonella, and other diseases spread through urine and droppings. A rat infestation is a property and health risk that warrants prompt treatment.

# Bed Bug Treatment Karachi  -  Khatmal Ka Khatma, Room by Room

Chemical spray plus IGR  -  a two-phase protocol that kills live bed bugs and stops hatching nymphs from restarting the infestation. 90-day guarantee.

✓ WHO-Approved Chemicals
✓ 90-Day Guarantee
✓ Same-Day Service

WhatsApp for a Quote →

## Understanding Khatmal  -  Why Bed Bugs Are Uniquely Difficult to Eliminate

Bed bugs (Cimex lectularius) are flat, reddish-brown insects roughly the size of an apple seed. Unlike most pests, they have no connection to food scraps or drainage  -  they feed exclusively on human blood, emerging from hiding in the 1–2 hours before dawn when occupants are in deepest sleep. A Karachi home can develop a severe infestation without any evidence of poor hygiene.

What makes khatmal particularly resilient is their biology. Adult females lay one to five eggs per day, cementing them into seams, cracks, and fabric folds where they are nearly invisible. Eggs incubate for 6–10 days and hatch into nymphs that begin feeding  -  and hiding  -  immediately. A single pregnant female introduced on a second-hand mattress or a guest's luggage can establish a full infestation within two months.

Bed bugs are also highly hitchhiker-capable: they travel between flats in apartment buildings through wall sockets and skirting board gaps, making a whole-room (and often whole-floor) treatment approach essential rather than treating one mattress in isolation.

Khatmal ka ilaj  -  bed bug treatment  -  must be systematic, room-wide, and multi-session. Treating the mattress surface alone while ignoring the bed frame, headboard, skirting boards, and adjacent upholstery leaves 80–90% of the infestation untouched.

## Why DIY Sprays and Repellents Don't Work on Bed Bugs

Off-the-shelf surface sprays, repellent strips, and camphor tablets are broadly ineffective against established bed bug infestations for three specific biological reasons:

Egg impermeability. Bed bug eggs are coated in a hard, waxy layer. Contact insecticides  -  even professional-grade ones  -  cannot penetrate this coating. Eggs simply wait out the spray and hatch days later.

Cryptic harborage. Bed bugs hide in locations that household sprays never reach: deep inside mattress tufting, inside electrical sockets and switch plates, behind loose wallpaper, inside hollow bed frame tubes, and beneath carpet edges. A surface spray treats 5–10% of where the population actually lives.

Dispersal under pressure. Repellents and strong-smelling products cause bed bugs to scatter from a primary harborage site into adjacent rooms and wall cavities  -  spreading an infestation that was previously contained.

Professional treatment is effective because it combines a residual insecticide (which remains active on treated surfaces for weeks) with an IGR that disrupts the moulting cycle of nymphs, ensuring that eggs which do hatch never develop into reproductive adults.

## SafaiKaro's Bed Bug Treatment Protocol

Our protocol is designed around the bed bug life cycle, not just the visible infestation:

🔍

### Thorough Inspection

Technician uses a torch and inspection probe to map every harborage point: mattress seams, box spring folds, bed frame joints and hollow tubes, headboard backing, skirting boards, electrical outlets, and upholstered furniture near the bed.

🛢

### Residual Spray  -  Session 1

WHO-approved residual insecticide applied to all mapped harborage points. Spray is worked into seams, cracks, and joints where live bugs and nymphs are congregating. Kills on contact and leaves a residual barrier that remains active for 3–4 weeks.

🔮

### IGR  -  Insect Growth Regulator

Applied alongside the residual spray. IGR is odourless and non-repellent  -  bed bugs cross treated surfaces without detecting it. It disrupts the hormonal pathway required for nymphs to moult into reproductive adults, stopping population growth at the source.

📋

### Follow-Up Session (Day 10–14)

The follow-up targets newly hatched nymphs before they can mature. This is the session that most DIY attempts skip  -  and the main reason infestations rebound after a single spray. SafaiKaro includes follow-up planning in every bed bug treatment.

### Preparation  -  What to Do Before Treatment

Strip all bedding and launder at 60°C (or use a dryer on high heat for 30 minutes)

Clear clutter from under and around the bed to expose harborage points

Do not move furniture to other rooms  -  this spreads the infestation

Vacate treated rooms (with pets) for 3–4 hours post-application

Do not vacuum or mop treated surfaces for at least 72 hours after treatment

Leave mattress encasements in place if already fitted

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are the signs of a bed bug infestation (khatmal)?

The most reliable signs are small rust-coloured blood stains on bedsheets; clusters of dark pepper-like droppings along mattress seams and bed frame joints; live or shed skins (pale translucent shells) in seams and tufts; and a musty, sweet smell in heavily infested rooms. Bites alone are unreliable  -  some people show no reaction at all.

Why does one spray session not eliminate bed bugs?

Bed bug eggs have a waxy, impermeable coating that most insecticides cannot penetrate. A single spray kills live bugs on contact but eggs hatch 7–14 days later. Professional treatment adds an IGR (insect growth regulator) that prevents hatching nymphs from maturing, and a follow-up session 10–14 days later targets newly emerged nymphs before they reproduce.

Do I need to throw away my mattress?

In the vast majority of cases, no. Professional residual spray + IGR treatment is far more effective than mattress disposal  -  and discarding without treating the room simply spreads the infestation to other furniture. After treatment, a mattress encasement (zip-up cover) is recommended to prevent re-harborage.

How many sessions does khatmal treatment require?

Most residential infestations need two sessions: the initial treatment and a follow-up at day 10–14. Severe infestations or properties with multiple heavily infested rooms may require a third session. SafaiKaro assesses infestation level at inspection and provides a clear plan before work begins.

Is the bed bug spray safe for children and pets?

SafaiKaro uses WHO-approved insecticides applied under food-safe and residential protocols. Residents and pets should vacate treated rooms for 3–4 hours while surfaces dry. Once dry and aired, areas are safe for normal use. Bedding should be laundered at 60°C before use after treatment.

## Bees vs. Wasps in Karachi  -  Very Different Problems, Very Different Risks

Karachi's warm climate and dense urban structure make it hospitable to several stinging insects that regularly nest in residential and commercial buildings. Understanding what you are dealing with is the first step  -  because bees and wasps require fundamentally different approaches.

🐝

### Honeybees (Shehad ki Makhi)

Golden-brown, hairy, build wax comb filled with honey. Typically nest in wall cavities, roof spaces, water tank housings, and hollow tree trunks. Relatively non-aggressive  -  defensive only when directly disturbed. Relocation by a beekeeper is possible and preferable. However, honeycombs left inside walls after removal attract other pests and cause structural moisture damage.

🐜

### Paper Wasps

Slender, smooth, black and yellow or reddish. Build open, umbrella-shaped paper nests under roof eaves, behind AC units, inside satellite dish brackets, and under balcony overhangs. Significantly more aggressive than bees  -  they sting without provocation when a person walks too close. Can sting multiple times. Small nests can become large very quickly in Karachi's heat.

⚡

### Hornets

Larger than wasps, black and white or black and yellow bands. Build enclosed, grey-paper football-shaped nests, often in trees, under roof overhangs, or inside attic spaces. Hornets are among the most aggressive stinging insects  -  a single hornet can release a pheromone alarm signal that recruits the entire colony to attack. Nest removal without professional equipment is acutely dangerous.

🚩

### Swarms

A honeybee swarm  -  a dense ball of thousands of bees resting temporarily on a branch, wall, or vehicle  -  looks alarming but is actually the safest and easiest point at which to relocate a colony. Swarms are docile (they have no nest to defend), but this window lasts only 24–72 hours before they establish a new permanent hive. Contact SafaiKaro promptly if you see a swarm.

Do not attempt DIY removal of wasp nests, hornets, or established beehives. A disturbed colony can mobilise within seconds. For allergy-unaware individuals, even a small number of stings can trigger anaphylaxis. Call SafaiKaro  -  we handle the risk so you don't have to.

## Why You Should Not Attempt Removal Yourself

The internet offers countless DIY methods for wasp and bee removal  -  boiling water, smoke, aerosol sprays at night. In practice, each of these approaches carries serious risk when applied to a substantial colony in an urban setting:

No protective equipment. A single misaimed spray or accidental knock triggers an immediate defensive swarm. Without a full-body bee suit, veil, and gloves, a partial response is dangerous.

Wrong time of day. Spraying a wasp nest at the wrong time means thousands of foragers are still outside the nest. They return to find the nest disturbed and become extremely aggressive  -  sometimes for 24+ hours.

Hidden anaphylaxis risk. Bee and wasp venom allergy is often unknown until the first major sting event. An allergic reaction to multiple stings  -  even in a person who has been stung before without reaction  -  can escalate to anaphylaxis within minutes without an EpiPen.

Residual honeycomb. Killing a bee colony inside a wall without removing the comb leaves kilograms of fermenting honey and wax. This attracts ants, cockroaches, and rodents, causes structural moisture damage, and will attract a new swarm within the same season.

### Nest and Comb Removal

After the colony is treated or relocated, the physical nest structure and (where accessible) any honeycomb is removed. This prevents residual attractant for new colonies and eliminates the structural moisture risk from fermenting honey.

5

## Sting Allergy and Medical Risk  -  Know Before You Approach

Bee and wasp venom allergy is more common than most people realise, and it can develop even in adults who have been stung without reaction before. If you or anyone in your household has:

Previously experienced swelling beyond the immediate sting site

Had hives, difficulty breathing, dizziness, or nausea after a sting

Been advised by a doctor to carry an epinephrine auto-injector (EpiPen)

 -  then under no circumstances should you approach an active nest, and you should move away from the area promptly and call SafaiKaro. Anaphylaxis from bee or wasp stings can progress to loss of consciousness within 5–15 minutes without treatment.

Even for individuals without known allergy, a mass-sting event involving more than 10–20 stings can cause toxic (non-allergic) venom overload with similar systemic symptoms. The proximity rule is simple: if in doubt, stay back and call a professional.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between bees and wasps?

Bees (including shehad ki makhi / honeybees) are rounder, hairier, and build wax combs with honey. They are defensive rather than aggressive. Wasps are slender, smooth, and more brightly banded  -  they are significantly more aggressive, can sting multiple times, and do not produce honey. Both require professional removal, but the approach and urgency differ considerably.

Is it dangerous to remove a beehive or wasp nest yourself?

Yes  -  significantly. Disturbing a hive without protective equipment triggers a defensive swarm within seconds. A single wasp can sting 10–15 times. For individuals with unknown bee/wasp allergy, a mass-sting event can cause anaphylaxis  -  a life-threatening reaction requiring immediate medical attention. Professional removal eliminates this risk entirely.

Can the honeybee colony be relocated rather than destroyed?

Where structurally feasible, SafaiKaro prioritises relocation for honeybee colonies. Relocation works best when the hive is accessible and hasn't penetrated deep into a wall void. When the hive is sealed inside a wall or roof space, treatment is required. Our technician assesses on-site and advises which approach is viable before work begins.

How quickly does a wasp nest need to be removed?

Wasp nests grow rapidly  -  a cricket-ball-sized nest can become football-sized within 6–8 weeks. Larger nests are harder to treat and colonies become more defensive as they grow. Active nests near doorways, children's areas, or AC vents should be treated within days. Fresh honeybee swarms (a tight ball resting on a surface) are easiest and safest to relocate within the first 24–72 hours  -  contact us promptly.

## Common Ants in Karachi Homes  -  Know Your Species

Ant infestations in Karachi are not one-size-fits-all problems. The species determines where the nest is located, what treatment approach works, and how urgently the problem needs to be addressed.

🧾

### Black Sugar Ants

The most common indoor ant in Karachi kitchens. Small, black or dark brown, and attracted to sugary and greasy foods. Nest in wall voids, behind skirting boards, under kitchen cabinets, and in garden soil near the building. Follow pheromone trails across countertops, into cupboards, and through electrical conduits.

🔴

### Red Fire Ants (Laal Cheonti)

Aggressive and venomous. Build soil mounds in gardens, lawns, and planters. Sting  -  not just bite  -  when disturbed, producing painful burning welts. Particular hazard for children playing in gardens and for pets. Fire ant colonies can number in the hundreds of thousands and require direct nest treatment rather than surface spray.

🔸

### Pharaoh Ants

Tiny, pale yellow ants that nest deep inside buildings  -  inside wall insulation, behind electrical sockets, and in cavity floors. Particularly problematic in apartment buildings because they migrate between units through wiring and pipe channels. Pharaoh ants are notoriously difficult to control with spray alone  -  they practise colony budding, fragmenting into new sub-colonies when threatened.

🔥

### Carpenter Ants

Large, black ants (6–12mm) that excavate galleries inside damp or softened wood  -  window and door frames, roof timbers, wooden furniture legs. Do not eat wood but remove it as shavings (frass). A carpenter ant presence near wooden fixtures warrants a structural assessment to check for moisture damage alongside the ant treatment.

Cheonti ka khatma  -  ant control  -  must target the colony, not just the trail. The workers you see foraging represent only 10–15% of the total colony. Killing them without reaching the queen and brood prolongs the infestation by weeks.

## Why Surface Sprays and Repellents Don't Solve Ant Infestations

Ants communicate via pheromone trails  -  invisible chemical signals that guide the colony to food sources and back to the nest. Standard DIY approaches fail for predictable reasons:

Spray kills foragers, not the queen. Contact sprays wipe out the visible trail workers. Within 24–48 hours, the colony sends a fresh cohort along the same route  -  or scouts a new one. The queen, larvae, and 85% of the colony are untouched inside the nest.

Repellents trigger budding in Pharaoh and fire ant colonies. Applying strong-smelling repellents to a Pharaoh ant trail causes the colony to split into multiple satellite nests  -  spreading the infestation instead of concentrating it. This is the opposite of the desired outcome.

Chalk and powder lines are temporary and ineffective indoors. Chalk lines block a trail for a few hours. Ants simply find another route  -  they are capable of covering an area of several hundred metres from their nest.

Professional ant control uses gel bait  -  a slow-acting, food-mimicking substance that foragers carry back to the colony and share with the queen and larvae. This trophallaxis (food-sharing) process is what spreads the active ingredient through the entire colony, including individuals the spray could never reach.

## SafaiKaro's Ant Treatment Approach

Our protocol is adapted to the species and infestation pattern identified during the technician's inspection:

🔍

### Trail and Nest Mapping

Technician traces active foraging trails to identify nest entry points and probable colony location  -  inside walls, under floors, in the garden, or in structural cavities. Species identification informs whether gel bait alone or a combined gel + nest drench is required.

💊

### Gel Bait  -  Trail Application

Slow-acting gel bait placed in small dots directly on active foraging trails, near nest entry cracks, and under appliances. Foragers carry the bait back as food, feeding the queen and brood. Colony population declines over 7–14 days as the bait works through the hierarchy.

🛣

### Residual Spray  -  Entry Points

Odourless residual insecticide applied to identified entry points (wall-floor junctions, pipe entry points, window sills, door frames), creating a treated barrier that kills crossing ants for weeks. Applied after bait placement to avoid repelling ants away from the bait.

🌿

### Garden Nest Treatment

For fire ant mounds and soil colonies in gardens or planters, direct nest drench treatment is applied  -  a liquid insecticide poured into and around the mound to penetrate the full colony depth. Significantly more effective than surface granules for established mounds.

### After Treatment  -  What to Expect

Increased forager activity in the first 3–5 days is normal  -  ants are collecting bait

Do not spray or wipe down gel bait placements  -  leave them undisturbed

Colony decline becomes visible after 7–14 days

Seal food in airtight containers to reduce competing food sources

Fix leaking pipes and moisture points  -  ants are often drawn to damp areas

90-day guarantee: if activity returns, SafaiKaro retreats at no extra charge

## Frequently Asked Questions

Why do ants keep coming back after spraying?

Surface sprays only kill the forager ants you can see  -  roughly 10–15% of the colony. The queen and larvae remain protected inside the nest. Within days, fresh foragers follow the same pheromone trail. Professional treatment uses gel bait that foragers carry back as food and share through the colony, reaching the queen and brood directly. Residual spray at entry points provides an additional barrier.

Are red fire ants (laal cheonti) dangerous?

Yes  -  fire ants sting (not just bite) when disturbed, producing a burning sensation and raised pustules. Children and pets are at particular risk from garden mounds. Fire ant colonies require direct nest drench treatment rather than surface sprays, as the mounds can extend 30–50cm into soil.

What is the difference between ant treatment and general fumigation?

General fumigation spray kills insects on contact across broad areas. Ant control is more targeted: slow-acting gel bait is placed on trails to be carried back to the nest, while residual spray secures entry points. Using fumigation spray without gel bait kills foragers but can trigger budding in Pharaoh and fire ant colonies  -  spreading the infestation rather than eliminating it.

Can carpenter ants damage my home?

Yes. Carpenter ants excavate galleries inside damp or softened wood  -  window frames, roof timbers, and door frames. They do not eat wood but remove it as fine frass (sawdust-like shavings). If you see large black ants emerging from wood or find frass near wooden fixtures, a structural assessment alongside treatment is recommended.

# Lizard Control Karachi  -  Chipkali Bhagane Ka Tarika, Properly Done

Chipkali follow insects. We eliminate the insects, apply repellents, and seal the gaps  -  an integrated approach that addresses why lizards enter, not just that they are there.

✓ WHO-Approved Chemicals
✓ 90-Day Guarantee
✓ Same-Day Service

WhatsApp for a Quote →

## Chipkali Kyu Aati Hai? Why Lizards Enter Karachi Homes

The common house gecko (Hemidactylus frenatus and Hemidactylus brookii) is Karachi's most frequently encountered household lizard. Chipkali are insectivores  -  their entire motivation for entering a building is the presence of a reliable insect food source. A home with a high lizard count invariably has an underlying insect infestation driving the population.

Geckos are adapted specifically to urban life: their toe pads allow them to walk on smooth vertical surfaces and ceilings, they are nocturnal and largely invisible during the day, and they thrive in the warm, humid conditions of Karachi's climate. A single gecko can consume 100+ insects per night, which is why their presence is a reliable indicator of insect pressure in the building.

💡

### Lights at Night

Outdoor and indoor lights attract flying insects  -  moths, flying ants, fungus gnats. Geckos congregate near light sources to feed on the assembled insects. Switching outdoor lighting to yellow-spectrum or LED bulbs reduces insect attraction and, indirectly, lizard activity.

🧽

### Cockroach Infestation

A cockroach infestation in the kitchen or drains provides a secondary food source for lizards beyond flying insects. Homes with both cockroaches and lizards need combined treatment  -  cockroach control removes the insect food supply at ground level, reducing the habitat value for geckos.

🔹

### Open Gaps and Entry Points

Geckos enter through gaps around pipe penetrations (AC units, drainage, plumbing), gaps under doors, unsealed conduit entry points, and poorly fitted window frames. A single 5–7mm gap is sufficient for a gecko to squeeze through. Sealing entry points prevents reinfestation after treatment.

💧

### Moisture and Dampness

Damp areas  -  leaking pipes behind walls, condensation under sinks, damp bathroom ceiling corners  -  attract insects (particularly drain flies and silverfish) which in turn attract lizards. Addressing moisture at source reduces insect activity and makes the property less attractive to geckos over time.

Chipkali bhagane ka sabse accha tarika  -  the best way to drive away lizards  -  is to remove what they are there for. Chasing individual lizards without treating the underlying insect population produces only temporary results. The lizards return because the food source remains.

## Home Remedies  -  What Works and What Doesn't

A wide variety of chipkali bhagane ke tarike circulate in Karachi  -  cloves, peacock feathers, eggshells, naphthalene balls, onions, coffee powder. The honest answer, based on pest management evidence rather than folklore:

Naphthalene balls (moth balls) may temporarily deter geckos from a specific small area due to the strong odour, but are toxic to humans and pets, dissipate quickly in Karachi's heat, and have no lasting effect on an established infestation. They address symptoms, not the food source.

Cloves, eggshells, and coffee powder have no documented scientific efficacy against geckos. Geckos habituate to novel stimuli in their environment within days.

Peacock feathers are a persistent folk remedy with no scientific basis  -  geckos do not respond to static visual deterrents.

Glue traps catch individual geckos but do nothing to reduce the insect food source. As long as insects are available, new geckos will move into the cleared territory.

Professional integrated treatment works because it addresses the root cause (insects), applies proven repellent compounds, and seals entry points  -  all three components simultaneously.

## SafaiKaro's Integrated Lizard Control Treatment

Lizard control requires a three-part integrated approach  -  none of the three steps alone produces a lasting result:

1

### Insect Food-Source Reduction

The first and most important step: professional fumigation treatment eliminates the insects that geckos feed on  -  cockroaches, mosquitoes, moths, flying ants, and drain flies. Without this step, lizards simply continue feeding after any repellent dissipates. SafaiKaro applies residual spray and targeted gel bait based on the insect species identified, using WHO-approved chemicals.

2

### Repellent Application to High-Activity Zones

Odour-based repellent compounds are applied to wall-ceiling junctions in rooms with high gecko activity, behind picture frames and electrical fittings, around light fixtures, and near AC unit openings. These compounds deter gecko movement on treated surfaces without posing a risk to human occupants.

3

### Entry Point Exclusion Advice

Technician identifies and documents active entry points: gaps around AC pipe penetrations, drain openings, gaps under doors, and unsealed conduit entries. Advice on sealing materials and methods is provided at no extra charge. Sealing entry points prevents new geckos from moving in as existing residents vacate due to reduced food supply and repellent treatment.

4

### Lighting Advice

Switching outdoor-facing lights to yellow-spectrum or LED bulbs significantly reduces the flying insect density on exterior walls and around entry points at night  -  directly reducing gecko congregation near doors and windows. This recommendation is included in the post-treatment brief.

### After Treatment  -  Realistic Expectations

Insect population drops within 1–2 weeks of fumigation treatment

Gecko activity reduces noticeably within 2–4 weeks as food supply diminishes

Complete gecko departure from treated areas can take 3–6 weeks

Individual gecko sightings in the first 4 weeks post-treatment are normal

Sealing entry points accelerates the clearance timeline significantly

90-day guarantee: if infestation persists, SafaiKaro returns at no extra charge

## Are Chipkali a Hygiene Risk? The Facts

House geckos are sometimes dismissed as harmless or even beneficial (they eat insects). While they are not venomous and do not bite humans unprovoked, they do present genuine hygiene concerns in residential settings:

Salmonella in droppings. Gecko droppings have been documented to carry Salmonella bacteria. Droppings on kitchen counters, inside kitchen cabinets, and near stored food present a contamination risk  -  particularly for young children and immunocompromised household members.

Food contamination. Geckos forage at night across kitchen surfaces, food-preparation areas, and inside storage. Food left uncovered overnight in a gecko-active kitchen is at risk of contamination from footpad contact and droppings.

Psychological distress. While not a medical issue, fear of lizards (herpetophobia) is common and significantly impacts quality of life for affected household members. Chipkali ka darr  -  the fear of house lizards  -  is a legitimate concern for many Karachi families.

For households with young children, elderly members, or anyone with a compromised immune system, professional lizard control combined with kitchen hygiene is the appropriate response to a visible gecko infestation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Chipkali kyu aati hai? Why do lizards come inside Karachi homes?

House geckos (chipkali) enter buildings in pursuit of insects  -  their food source. A home with visible lizard activity almost always has an underlying insect infestation sustaining them. Lights left on at night attract flying insects, which attract geckos to illuminated walls and ceilings. Eliminating the insect population through professional fumigation is the most effective first step.

Are chipkali harmful in the home?

House geckos are not venomous, but their droppings carry Salmonella bacteria. Droppings on kitchen surfaces, inside cabinets, and near food pose a genuine contamination risk  -  particularly for young children and immunocompromised household members. Food left uncovered overnight in gecko-active kitchens is at risk of contact contamination.

What is the most effective chipkali bhagane ka tarika?

The most effective and lasting approach is integrated: professional fumigation to remove the insect food source, repellent application to surfaces lizards frequent, and sealing of entry points. Home remedies like cloves, eggshells, and peacock feathers have no documented scientific efficacy. Naphthalene balls dissipate quickly and are toxic to household members.

Will fumigation alone get rid of lizards?

Fumigation significantly reduces lizard activity by removing the insect food supply  -  this is the essential foundation. However, geckos already established in wall cavities or behind false ceilings may persist temporarily. The repellent and exclusion steps of SafaiKaro's integrated treatment address resident lizards and prevent new ones from entering after the insect population drops.

How much does lizard control cost in Karachi?

Fixed pricing by size: small apartments up to 100 sq yd from Rs 7,000; medium homes (101–200 sq yd) Rs 11,000; large homes (201–300 sq yd) Rs 13,000; larger homes (301–500 sq yd) Rs 16,000; XL/villas (501–1,000 sq yd) Rs 20,000. Includes insect fumigation, repellent application, and exclusion advice. Full details at pest-control-price-list-karachi.

## What Is a Fumigation Certificate?

A fumigation certificate  -  also called a pest control certificate  -  is an official document issued by a licensed pest control company after completing a treatment at your premises. It confirms that a professional fumigation was carried out on a specific date, using approved chemicals, by certified technicians.

In Pakistan, this document carries practical weight. Sindh Food Authority (SFA) requires food businesses to demonstrate active pest control compliance during license registration and inspections. Health departments, property management companies, and corporate building managers also request it as part of occupancy and renewal requirements.

The certificate is not just a piece of paper  -  it is proof that your premises have been professionally treated and are compliant with food safety and hygiene standards.

### What a SafaiKaro Certificate Includes

Premises name, address, and type of facility

Date of treatment (treatment day certificate issuance)

Chemicals used  -  formulations, active ingredients

Areas treated (kitchen, dining, storage, etc.)

Technician name

Company stamp and authorized signature

Recommended next treatment date

## Who Needs a Fumigation Certificate in Karachi?

If your business handles food, serves the public, or operates within a regulated commercial space  -  a fumigation certificate is either legally required or practically essential.

🍽

### Restaurants & Cafes

Sindh Food Authority requires pest control documentation for food business license registration and annual renewal. A certificate from a licensed provider  -  like SafaiKaro  -  satisfies this requirement.

🍪

### Bakeries & Food Outlets

Any business producing or selling food products is subject to SFA inspections. Cockroach or rodent activity in a bakery is a license-suspension risk. Monthly fumigation with certificates is standard practice.

☀

### Cloud Kitchens

Aggregator platforms and shared kitchen operators increasingly require pest control certificates from tenants. A certificate on file protects your listing and avoids penalty delistings.

🏨

### Hotels & Guesthouses

Hotels need pest control certificates for PTDC registration, star-rating audits, and corporate client contracts. Bed bug incidents without documented prevention history are difficult to defend.

🏫

### Schools & Institutions

Schools with canteens or kitchens, hospitals, clinics, and healthcare facilities require documented pest control. Annual or quarterly treatment certificates satisfy most institutional compliance requirements.

🏢

### Offices & Commercial Buildings

Building management companies in DHA and Clifton require tenants and operators to maintain pest control records. A certificate covers lease requirements and building compliance audits.

🏭

### Warehouses & Storage

Warehouses storing food goods, pharmaceuticals, or import/export cargo need pest control documentation. Fumigation certificates are required for Karachi port container clearance and cargo storage audits.

🛒

### Retail & Supermarkets

Supermarkets, grocery stores, and convenience stores require pest-free status for trade license maintenance. Certificate documentation protects against SFA spot checks.

## Why Schools and Daycares Need Scheduled Pest Control

A school is one of the most sensitive environments a pest control company can be asked to treat. Children spend six to eight hours a day in classrooms, sit on floors, eat in canteens, and touch every surface within reach. When cockroaches appear in a corridor, ants invade a tiffin, or a rat is spotted near the canteen, it is not only a hygiene problem  -  it is a trust problem with parents who expect the premises to be safe.

Karachi's climate makes this harder. Warm temperatures, monsoon humidity, and dense urban surroundings mean schools face year-round pressure from cockroaches, ants, rodents, and mosquitoes. A reactive approach  -  calling someone only after a child reports a pest  -  almost always means treating during school hours, exposing children to chemicals at the wrong time, and dealing with anxious parents. Scheduled, planned pest control avoids all of that.

There are four reasons schools in Karachi move to a planned schedule rather than ad-hoc spraying:

Children's health comes first. Young children are more sensitive to pests and to careless chemical application. A planned visit means the right chemical, the right dose, the right time  -  never a panicked spray in a room full of students.

Monsoon brings dengue. From July through September, standing water in courtyards, planters, water tanks, and blocked drains breeds Aedes mosquitoes that carry dengue. Schools are a known transmission setting because so many children gather in one place.

The canteen is a hotspot. Any place that prepares or stores food attracts cockroaches, flies, ants, and rodents. A school canteen needs the same hygiene discipline as a restaurant kitchen.

Timing matters. Treatment has to fit around the academic calendar  -  never during exam season in occupied halls, ideally during weekends, after dismissal, or in term breaks.

The goal is simple: a pest-free, child-safe campus that is treated when no children are present, documented for the administration, and planned around the school calendar  -  not the other way around.

## Why Restaurant Pest Control Is Non-Negotiable in Karachi

In the restaurant business, pests are not a maintenance issue  -  they are an existential one. One customer photo of a cockroach on a plate, posted to Instagram or a Google review, can do more damage in an afternoon than a year of marketing can repair. And in Karachi, where Sindh Food Authority inspectors actively visit, seal, and publicise non-compliant kitchens, an infestation is also a licensing risk.

A commercial kitchen is, from a pest's point of view, the perfect home: warmth, water, food, and dozens of hidden harbourage points behind equipment and inside drains. Without a structured program, the population rebuilds between visits and you are forever firefighting. The businesses that stay clean are the ones that treat pest control as part of operations  -  scheduled, documented, and built into the closing routine.

The three pests that close kitchens in Karachi are predictable:

Cockroaches migrate up from kitchen drains and breed in wall voids near heat and moisture. They are the single most common health-inspection violation and the one customers notice first.

Rodents follow food into storerooms and dry-goods areas. They contaminate stock, gnaw packaging and wiring, and leave droppings that fail any hygiene audit.

Flies breed in drains, bins, and standing waste, then move freely between the bin area and the pass  -  a direct contamination route over plated food.

The cost of pest control is trivial compared with a sealed kitchen, a viral review, or a suspended licence. A monthly program with documentation is the cheapest insurance a restaurant can buy.

Premium villas, large gardens, bed bugs

### Phase 7

Active construction, pre-construction treatment

### Phase 7 Extension

Newest area, Annual Shield recommended

### Phase 8

Khayaban-e-Jinnah, mosquitoes, standing water

## Pest Control in DHA Phase 1 Karachi

DHA Phase 1 is the oldest part of the Defence Housing Authority  -  bungalows here were built in the 1960s and early 1970s, many of them with timber roof beams, wooden window frames, and original masonry that has had six decades to develop cracks, gaps, and cavities. Those structural features are precisely what make Phase 1 homes the highest-risk zone for drywood and subterranean termites in all of DHA.

The mature trees lining Phase 1’s streets add another layer of pest pressure. Tree roots disturb underground drainage pipes, creating moisture pathways that attract subterranean termites. Fallen leaf litter and decomposing mulch near boundary walls are breeding grounds for cockroaches and ants. Homes backing onto the creek in Phase 1 see mosquito activity year-round, not just in monsoon.

Our approach in Phase 1 starts with a structural assessment before any chemical is applied. We check roof beams, window frames, and skirting boards for active termite galleries. For confirmed termite infestations we use a soil injection + bait station combination that is more effective than surface spray alone in old-construction homes. Our termite work in Phase 1 comes with a three-year structural guarantee.

General fumigation for Phase 1 bungalows is priced per square yard  -  a standard 200-sq-yard bungalow costs Rs 11,000. If you are renovating or extending your Phase 1 property, book a pre-treatment consultation before any excavation work disturbs existing termite colonies and drives them deeper into the structure.

## Pest Control in DHA Phase 2 Karachi

DHA Phase 2 runs along the Khayaban-e-Ittehad corridor and contains one of the highest concentrations of restaurants, bakeries, and commercial food outlets in all of DHA. That commercial strip creates a constant food and moisture source that sustains large cockroach populations  -  American cockroach (Periplaneta americana) colonies thrive in the shared drainage infrastructure that runs beneath these blocks.

Residential homes in Phase 2 face a spillover effect: commercial pest populations do not respect property boundaries. Cockroaches moving through shared boundary walls and drainage manholes are a daily reality for Phase 2 residents. A single fumigation that treats your home without addressing shared drainage entry points will see reinfestation within weeks. SafaiKaro’s Phase 2 protocol specifically includes drainage cover treatment and perimeter gel baiting at all potential re-entry points.

Phase 2 also has a significant rodent population centred around the commercial area. Rats travel along the backs of restaurants to residential kitchens through utility cable ducts and broken drain covers. Our rodent control in Phase 2 uses tamper-resistant bait stations placed at utility entry points rather than conventional trapping alone, which is more effective in high-reinfestation-pressure environments.

For Phase 2 businesses  -  restaurants, cafes, grocery stores  -  we offer a dedicated commercial programme with monthly service visits, documentation for health inspections, and WHO-approved chemicals that are safe for food-preparation environments. See our commercial service.

## Pest Control in DHA Phase 4 Karachi

DHA Phase 4 was primarily developed in the 1980s and represents a transitional generation of construction  -  properties are newer than Phase 1 and 2 but old enough that original cement rendering has cracked, plumbing has aged, and many homes have undergone at least one major renovation. Renovation work is the single biggest driver of pest activity in Phase 4: when walls are opened, pest colonies that have been dormant for years are suddenly disturbed and scatter through the structure.

The most common call we receive from Phase 4 is after a kitchen or bathroom renovation  -  cockroach colonies that were contained behind old tiles suddenly appear throughout the home. The solution is not simply to spray; the displaced colony needs to be traced to all secondary harborage points before treatment. Our Phase 4 technicians carry gel bait, IGR (insect growth regulator), and crack-and-crevice injection equipment specifically for post-renovation dispersal scenarios.

Rodent activity in Phase 4 is linked to renovation patterns as well. Demolition of original concrete floors disturbs underground burrow networks. Norway rats displaced from demolition sites move into adjacent properties through foundation gaps. We see a clear spike in Phase 4 rodent call-outs in the weeks following any large construction or renovation project on a neighbouring plot.

If you are planning a renovation in Phase 4, the most cost-effective approach is a pre-renovation treatment followed by a post-renovation re-treatment once work is complete. We offer a bundled package for this. Contact us to book an inspection before your contractor starts work.

## Pest Control in DHA Phase 5 Karachi

DHA Phase 5 is the most densely populated phase in all of DHA  -  Khayaban-e-Shahbaz, Khayaban-e-Hafiz, and the surrounding khayabans contain over 800 residential homes and a dense network of apartment buildings, commercial plazas, and service lanes. That density means pest pressure from one property rapidly transmits to neighbours, making Phase 5 SafaiKaro’s most active service area by volume.

Apartments in Phase 5 present specific challenges that single-unit bungalow treatments do not address. Cockroaches in apartment buildings travel through shared risers, electrical conduit, and inter-unit gaps between floors. A treatment limited to one flat will see reinfestation within days from adjacent units. We strongly recommend building-wide fumigation in Phase 5 apartment blocks  -  we offer block-rate pricing for buildings where 4 or more units book together.

Mosquito activity in Phase 5 is driven by a combination of open storm drains along the khayabans and ornamental water features in garden landscapes. We apply WHO-approved larvicide to outdoor breeding sites as part of every Phase 5 general fumigation  -  not as an add-on. This dramatically reduces re-infestation rates in the 30 days following treatment.

Bed bug cases in Phase 5 are growing, particularly in furnished apartment rentals and homes of frequent travellers. Bed bugs are not a cleanliness issue  -  they travel in luggage and second-hand furniture. Our bed bug treatment for Phase 5 uses a heat-and-chemical combination protocol. A standard 200-sq-yard home is treated in under 4 hours, and we offer a 90-day re-treatment guarantee specific to bed bug cases. Book a same-day inspection if you have noticed bites.

## Pest Control in DHA Phase 6 Karachi

DHA Phase 6 is DHA’s premium villa belt  -  large 500 to 1,000+ square yard properties with manicured gardens, swimming pools, imported wood furniture, and high-value soft furnishings. The pest profile here is different from earlier phases: subterranean termites in ornamental garden timber, mosquitoes breeding in decorative water features, and bed bugs arriving through international travel are the three dominant concerns.

Large gardens in Phase 6 create significant termite habitat. Wooden garden furniture, pergolas, and boundary wall planters give subterranean termites a stepping stone from soil to the main structure. We have identified cases in Phase 6 where termite infestations in valuable antique furniture were traced back to garden planter boxes that were never treated. Our Phase 6 termite programme covers the full perimeter  -  garden structures included, not just the house.

Phase 6 residents travel internationally at above-average rates, and bed bugs are a returning traveller’s most common pest import. We see a clear peak in Phase 6 bed bug call-outs following summer holidays and school breaks. Our service for Phase 6 is discreet  -  unmarked vehicles on request, early-morning or evening appointments to minimise visibility, and no signage placed on the property.

Mosquito breeding in ornamental ponds and swimming pool overflow areas is a year-round problem in Phase 6. We install long-acting larvicide tablets in all standing water points and apply residual insecticide to shaded wall surfaces where adult mosquitoes rest during the day. This combination reduces adult mosquito populations by over 90% within 72 hours and lasts 4 to 6 weeks.

## Pest Control in DHA Phase 7 Karachi

DHA Phase 7 has been under active construction for several years and represents one of the most complex pest environments in Karachi. Construction zones are a natural amplifier for pest populations: excavation disturbs subterranean termite and rodent colonies, open plots accumulate standing water, and construction waste creates harborage for cockroaches and rats. Once your building is complete, you are surrounded by active construction sites that continually regenerate pest pressure.

Pre-construction termite proofing is the single most important service we offer Phase 7 plot owners. Applied before the foundation slab is poured, soil treatment with Chlorpyrifos or Imidacloprid creates a chemical barrier that prevents subterranean termites from migrating up through the slab into the structure. Post-construction treatment is still possible but requires drilling and injection  -  it is more disruptive, more expensive, and less comprehensive. If you have a Phase 7 plot under construction, book the pre-construction treatment before your slab is poured.

Rodents are a persistent challenge in Phase 7 because neighbouring open plots constantly regenerate burrow networks. Standard bait placement works, but in active construction environments we recommend monthly service visits rather than a one-off treatment  -  the rat population resets from neighbouring plots within 30 to 60 days if ongoing pressure is not maintained.

For newly completed Phase 7 homes, our First-Home Package bundles a general fumigation with a termite inspection and a rodent survey into a single visit at a combined rate. We will identify any vulnerabilities before you move furniture in and advise on construction defects  -  unsealed utility entries, improper drainage falls  -  that will cause recurring pest problems if not addressed before move-in.

## Pest Control in DHA Phase 7 Extension Karachi

DHA Phase 7 Extension is the newest developed area within the Phase 7 zone  -  properties here have been completed and occupied more recently than core Phase 7, and many residents are moving in for the first time in the past one to three years. New construction does not mean pest-free: the surrounding undeveloped land, open nullahs, and proximity to Phase 7’s active construction sites creates sustained external pest pressure from day one of occupancy.

The most common problem we see in Phase 7 Extension is subterranean termite migration from adjacent open plots. Termites do not need a food source inside your home to enter  -  they explore constantly, and once they find timber in a new structure they establish feeding colonies quickly. If your home was not pre-construction treated (many contractor-built homes in this area were not), we strongly recommend a post-construction soil injection treatment before any wooden fixtures or furniture are installed.

Mosquitoes are a major quality-of-life issue in Phase 7 Extension due to the undeveloped land bordering the residential blocks. Standing water in open plots, construction debris, and poorly graded terrain collects rainwater that serves as mosquito breeding habitat for weeks after rain. Our mosquito programme for Phase 7 Extension covers outdoor perimeter fogging, larvicide application to breeding sites on your plot, and residual spray on external wall surfaces.

Because external pest pressure in Phase 7 Extension is ongoing  -  unlike in established phases where the environment has stabilised  -  we strongly recommend the Annual Shield plan over one-off treatments. Four visits a year with 1 emergency callout between visits means that any reinfestation from neighbouring plots is addressed quickly before it becomes an established infestation. Annual Shield for a 200-sq-yard home in Phase 7 Extension is Rs 24,000 per year.

## Pest Control in DHA Phase 8 Karachi

DHA Phase 8 lines Khayaban-e-Jinnah  -  the eastern spine of DHA that borders the Karachi coastline and the network of nullahs that drain towards the creek. That geography creates the defining pest challenge of Phase 8: mosquito breeding. The nullahs and low-lying areas along Phase 8’s eastern boundary collect and hold standing water after rain and even during dry periods through seepage from the sea. Aedes and Culex mosquitoes breed in this stagnant water year-round, making Phase 8 one of the highest-mosquito-risk residential zones in Karachi.

SafaiKaro is headquartered in DHA Phase 8  -  our office at 54-C Al Murtaza Commercial Lane 2 means we have technicians on-site in Phase 8 daily. Response times here are the fastest of any area we cover. Same-day service for emergency call-outs is almost always available regardless of the time of booking.

Beyond mosquitoes, Phase 8’s proximity to the nullah network also brings rodent pressure. Norway rats follow water channels as navigation corridors and enter residential properties through drain outlets and broken manhole covers. Our rodent programme in Phase 8 prioritises entry-point sealing and drain cover inspection in addition to bait station placement  -  blocking the entry route is more durable than simply baiting.

Phase 8 is also home to a growing number of commercial developments  -  plazas, clinics, and food outlets along Khayaban-e-Jinnah. For commercial clients in Phase 8 we offer dedicated monthly pest management with full documentation for regulatory inspections. For residents, our Annual Shield plan at Phase 8 is our most popular offering: four scheduled visits a year keep mosquito and rodent populations under control without requiring residents to remember to rebook.

FAQ

## DHA Pest Control  -  Common Questions

Which DHA phases does SafaiKaro cover?

SafaiKaro covers all 8 DHA phases  -  Phase 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, Phase 7 Extension, and Phase 8. Same-day service is available across all phases if you book before 10am. Phase 5, 6, and 8 have the highest technician density and the fastest response times.

What is the price for pest control in DHA Karachi?

General fumigation starts from Rs 7,000 for homes up to 100 sq yards, and Rs 11,000 for 101–200 sq yards. Termite treatment starts from Rs 13,000. Annual Shield plans start from Rs 18,000 per year. All prices are the same across all 8 DHA phases and are confirmed before work starts  -  no hidden charges.

Do you offer pre-construction termite treatment for DHA Phase 7?

Yes  -  pre-construction termite proofing is available for all DHA Phase 7 and Phase 7 Extension plots under construction. Soil treatment is applied before your foundation slab is poured. This is the most effective and least expensive termite protection method. Contact us before your slab date to schedule.

Mosquito problem hai Phase 8 mein  -  kya karein?

Phase 8’s proximity to the nullah network creates year-round mosquito breeding. We apply larvicide to all standing water points on your plot and residual insecticide to shaded external wall surfaces. Mosquito populations reduce by over 90% within 72 hours. For ongoing protection, our Annual Shield plan includes four visits per year plus 1 emergency callout between visits.

What is the Annual Shield plan and is it worth it for DHA?

Annual Shield is a 12-month plan with 4 scheduled visits per year plus 1 emergency callout between visits if pests return between visits. It covers cockroaches, ants, mosquitoes, and rodents. For DHA homes in phases with high external pest pressure  -  Phase 7, Phase 7 Extension, and Phase 8  -  it is significantly more cost-effective than reactive one-off treatments. Prices start at Rs 18,000/year for homes up to 100 sq yards.

Response times here are the fastest of any area we cover. Same-day service for emergency call-outs is almost always available regardless of the time of booking.

Beyond mosquitoes, Phase 8’s proximity to the nullah network also brings rodent pressure. Norway rats follow water channels as navigation corridors and enter residential properties through drain outlets and broken manhole covers. Our rodent programme in Phase 8 prioritises entry-point sealing and drain cover inspection in addition to bait station placement  -  blocking the entry route is more durable than simply baiting.

Phase 8 is also home to a growing number of commercial developments  -  plazas, clinics, and food outlets along Khayaban-e-Jinnah. For commercial clients in Phase 8 we offer dedicated monthly pest management with full documentation for regulatory inspections. For residents, our Annual Shield plan at Phase 8 is our most popular offering: four scheduled visits a year keep mosquito and rodent populations under control without requiring residents to remember to rebook.

FAQs

## Common Questions from Karachi Businesses

Is pest control mandatory for food businesses in Pakistan?
⌄

While Pakistan doesn't have a universal federal mandate, Sindh Food Authority and local health departments require restaurants and food processing units to maintain pest control records. A fumigation certificate is commonly required for food business licenses.

Can I get a fumigation certificate for my business?
⌄

Yes  -  SafaiKaro issues official fumigation certificates after every commercial treatment. These are accepted by health departments, property management companies, and licensing authorities.

How often should a commercial property be fumigated?
⌄

Monthly for restaurants and food businesses. Quarterly for offices and retail. Bi-monthly for warehouses. Frequency depends on pest pressure and regulatory requirements.

What certifications should a commercial pest control company have?
⌄

Look for WHO-approved chemical usage and proper insurance. SafaiKaro holds both.

Khatmal Ka Ilaj Karachi

# Khatmal Ka Ilaj Karachi  -  Bed Bug Treatment Ka Complete Guide

SafaiKaro Team
June 2026
12 min read

Khatmal
Bed Bugs
Karachi
DHA
Clifton

Subah utho aur body pe red bites hon  -  yeh khatmal ka classic sign hai. Karachi mein khatmal (bed bugs) ki problem tezi se badh rahi hai  -  aur sirf gande ya puraane ghar mein nahi. DHA ke naye apartments, Clifton ke high-rise flats, PECHS ke purane bungalows  -  khatmal kahin bhi aa sakte hain.

Yeh guide aapko sab kuch batayegi jo khatmal ke baare mein jaanna chahiye: kya hote hain, kaise pehchanen, kahan chhupte hain, DIY sprays kyun fail hote hain, professional treatment ka exact process kya hai, aur Karachi mein bed bug treatment ki actual cost kitni hai.

Sab kuch seedha, honest, aur Roman Urdu mein  -  jaise SafaiKaro ka tareeqa hai.

## Khatmal Kya Hote Hain?  -  کھٹمل (Bed Bugs in Urdu)

Khatmal  -  yaani bed bugs  -  chote khoon peene wale insects hain. Yeh raat ko active hote hain, insaan ya jaanwar ka khoon peete hain, aur din mein mattress ke seams, bed frame ke joints, ya deewar ke darraron mein chhup jaate hain.

Kuch zaroori facts:

Rang: Chote hote hain toh translucent/cream rang ke hote hain. Bade (adult) khatmal flat, oval shape ke, mahogany brown rang ke hote hain  -  approximately apple seed ke size ke.

Khoon peene ke baad: Body phool ke dark red ho jaati hai aur round shape le leti hai.

Kaise phaelte hain: Khatmal udte ya chalte nahi phaelte  -  yeh luggage, second-hand furniture, kapde, ya shared bedding ke zariye ek jagah se doosri jagah move karte hain.

Karachi mein khatmal kyun zyada: Hotels, guesthouses, bachelors' hostels, aur second-hand furniture market se spread hota hai. Ek infested hotel room mein ek raat guzaarna kaafi hai  -  khatmal aapke suitcase ya kapdon mein ghar aa jaate hain.

Important: Khatmal ka matlab gandagi nahi hai. Cleanest ghar mein bhi khatmal aa sakte hain  -  ek infested luggage ya used sofa kaafi hai. Yeh social stigma galat hai.

## Khatmal Ko English Mein Kya Kehte Hain?

Khatmal in English is "bed bug" (کھٹمل = bed bug). Bed bugs are small, reddish-brown, blood-feeding insects that hide in mattress seams and bed frames and bite at night.

Khatmal ko English mein "bed bug" kehte hain (Urdu: کھٹمل), scientific name Cimex lectularius. Yeh chota, reddish-brown, khoon peene wala insect hai jo raat ko active hota hai aur din mein mattress seams ya bed frame mein chhupta hai, isi liye ise English mein bed bug kaha jata hai.

## Khatmal Ka Professional Ilaj, Rs 11,000 Se

DIY aur market spray try karne se pehle time aur paise waste na karein. SafaiKaro ka bed bug treatment WHO-approved chemicals, IGR, aur 90-day guarantee ke saath Rs 11,000 se shuru hota hai.

Bed Bug Treatment Dekhein →

WhatsApp Ab, +92 330 8652035

## Khatmal Ki Pehchaan  -  Yeh 5 Signs Zaroor Check Karein

Khatmal ki problem confirm karne ke liye yeh signs dekhein:

### 1. Skin Pe Bites  -  Pattern Identify Karein

Khatmal ke bites aksar cluster ya line mein hote hain  -  3-5 bites ek straight ya curved pattern mein. Mostly exposed skin pe hote hain: arms, shoulders, neck, face. Bites red, itchy welts hote hain jo mosquito bite se bade hote hain. Subah utho toh zyada visible hote hain.

### 2. Bedsheet Pe Rust-Colored Stains

Bedsheet ya pillow cover pe chote rust-colored ya brown stains? Yeh khatmal ka khoon hai  -  jab aap neend mein khatmal ko crush karte hain. Yeh ek bilkul clear sign hai ke active infestation hai.

### 3. Mattress Ke Seams Mein Eggs Ya Skins

Mattress ke edges aur piping (stitched border) ko closely inspect karein. Chote white/cream eggs (poppy seed size), aur shed skins (khatmal grow karte waqt apni outer skin chhod dete hain)  -  dono active infestation confirm karte hain.

### 4. Dark Spots (Droppings)

Khatmal ke droppings kaale ya dark brown chote dots hote hain. Yeh mattress seams, bed frame, deewar ke paas, ya skirting boards pe nazar aa sakte hain.

### 5. Musty Smell

Heavy infestation mein ek specific musty, sweet-ish smell aati hai  -  yeh khatmal ke pheromones hain. Agar kamray mein yeh smell notice karo, khatmal ki badi colony ho sakti hai.

Ek bhi sign dikh raha hai toh delay mat karo. Khatmal ki ek female month mein 200-250 eggs de sakti hai. 6 hafte mein choti problem badi colony ban jaati hai.

## Khatmal Kahan Chhupte Hain? Inspection Guide

Khatmal prefer karte hain ke host (aap) ke bilkul paas rahen. Isliye yeh jagahein sabse pehle check karein:

### Primary Hiding Spots

Mattress seams aur piping: Sabse common spot. Mattress ke har edge aur stitched border carefully dekhen.

Bed frame aur headboard: Wooden ya metal frame ke joints, screws ke holes, aur headboard ke peechhe.

Box spring: Agar hai toh cover hata ke andar dekhen  -  bohot common hiding spot.

Side table aur drawers: Bed ke bilkul paas rakhay furniture ke hinges, undersides, aur drawers.

### Secondary Hiding Spots

Upholstered sofas aur chairs ke cushion folds aur arm seams

Curtain rods aur curtain fabric ke folds

Electrical sockets aur switches (especially deewar se close bed wale)

Deewar aur skirting board ke daraar

Peeling wallpaper ya loose wall paint ke neeche

Kitaaben, picture frames, aur clutter (heavily infested ghar mein)

Inspection tip: Ek credit card le ke mattress seams ke saath slide karein  -  agar khatmal hain toh baahar nikalenge. Torch ya flashlight use karein kyunki yeh roshan jagah se bhaagte hain.

## DIY Spray Aur Market Products Kyun Fail Hote Hain?

Bahut log pehle market spray try karte hain  -  aur fail ho jaate hain. Wajah simple hai:

Eggs pe koi asar nahi: Market mein available sprays eggs ko kill nahi karte. Aap adults maar dete ho  -  2-3 hafte mein nayi generation aa jaati hai.

Chemical resistance: Karachi mein decades se same pyrethroids market sprays mein hain. Khatmal ki local populations ne kaafi resistance develop kar li hai.

Diluted concentration: Over-the-counter sprays mein chemical concentration bohot low hoti hai  -  professional grade se kahin kam effective.

Coverage problem: Spray wahan nahi pohoncha jaata jahan khatmal chhupe hain  -  mattress seams ke andar, bed frame ke andar, deewar ke darraron mein. Surface spray sirf exposed insects maarta hai.

No IGR: Professional treatment mein IGR (Insect Growth Regulator) bhi hota hai  -  yeh nymphs aur eggs ko mature hone se rokta hai. Market sprays mein yeh nahi hota.

Honest verdict: Market spray se time aur paise waste hote hain. 2-3 baar try karne ke baad log professional ke paas aate hain  -  lekin colony aur badi ho chuki hoti hai. Pehli baar hi professional karwao  -  time aur total cost dono bachaoge.

## Market Spray Fail Ho Gaya? Ab Professional Karwao

SafaiKaro ka khatmal treatment Rs 11,000 se shuru hota hai, dono sessions aur 90-day guarantee included, koi hidden charges nahi.
